# Adding a Sort Button to Main Page (2026-02-04 23:44Z)

_**User (2026-02-04 23:53Z)**_

On the Main page there are currently three buttons in the upper left corner. From left to right they are Refresh, Layout, and Filter (See Houdoku Main Page Buttons Screenshot 2026-02-04 161804.jpg). I would like to add a fourth button named “Sort”. I want this button to be located between Refresh and Layout. I want this button to be identical to the Layout button, including over dimensions, background color, font size, and font color. I also want the Sort button drop-down menu layout and function to be identical to the Layout button. I want to move the following options from the Layout button to the Sort button. From the Layout button move the title text Sort, Title, Date Last Read, and Unread to the Sort button. Then to the Sort button add another type of sort option called “Chapter Update”. Place this new option just below the Date Last Read. Make the new Chapter Update work in the exact same way as the Date Last Read.

In the Layout button where the sort option was located place the following:
Title: “All Series Library: Display Cards” (allow wrapping if required).
First option: “All”
Second option: “Filter by Category”
If the All option is selected then all of the Series cards will be displayed in the All Series category. Currently this is the default. Continue to take into account the Filter options (default).
If the Filter by Category is selected then only the Series card that do not have a category set for them will be shown in the All Series category. Continue to take into account the Filter options (default).
Make sure that no changes cause issues with the operation of the program including Lint and Release actions.

Let me break down what the user is asking for:
